allow: PowerShell(sc.exe start NovaService | Out-Null; Start-Sleep -Seconds 12; \(Get-Service NovaService\).Status; $p = Get-Process nova-server -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($p\) { "nova-server PIDs: " + \($p.Id -join ', '\) } else { "no process yet" })

Bash(cd "/c/Program Files/Nova Server" && echo "=== most recent startup banners \(worker\) ==="; grep -nE "Nova  started at|Nova Worker|NVENC READY|Elevated token|Running as SYSTEM" nova.log | tail -8; echo; echo "=== nova.log last-modified vs now ==="; date; stat -c '%y' nova.log)

PowerShell(sc.exe stop NovaService | Out-Null; Start-Sleep -Seconds 8; Copy-Item "C:\\Users\\nova-server\\target\\release\\nova-server.exe" "C:\\Program Files\\Nova Server\\nova-server.exe" -Force; $a=\(Get-FileHash "C:\\Program Files\\Nova Server\\nova-server.exe" -Algorithm MD5\).Hash; $b=\(Get-FileHash "C:\\Users\\nova-server\\target\\release\\nova-server.exe" -Algorithm MD5\).Hash; "exe match: " + \($a -eq $b\); sc.exe start NovaService | Out-Null; Start-Sleep -Seconds 10; \(Get-Service NovaService\).Status)
